subjects.subject: Religion
topics: Unit 1: God Gives Us Life & Love
Chapter 2: Jesus is God's Best Gift
Chapter 1: God is the Giver of Gifts
studyNotes: Jesus is God's greatest gift to us; he tells us about God and teaches us how to live.
Jesus gave us the new life of grace.
Jesus died for our sins; He is our Savior.
Jesus is like a seed: a seed dies for a new plant to grow, and Jesus died so we can have new life (grace).
We are called to be disciples, friends of Jesus.
Mary is Jesus' mother and the mother of the Church, so she is our mother too.
We are made in God's image and likeness; we can think, choose, and love.
The Trinity is three persons in one God: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
We use our senses to enjoy God's gifts, care for creation, and thank God for creation.
